# Club LRE

> Sitio oficial del Club Los Rosarinos Estudiantil (CLUB L.R.E), una institución deportiva y social de Rosario, Argentina, fundada en 1943.

This file helps AI assistants and crawlers understand the project structure. For complete API documentation of the UI library used (HeroUI v3), see `https://heroui.com/llms.txt`.

## Project

- **Type**: Next.js 16 (App Router) website
- **UI library**: HeroUI v3 (`@heroui/react` + `@heroui/styles`)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-based config, no JS)
- **Language**: TypeScript 6
- **Theme**: `next-themes` (light/dark), default dark
- **Node**: 22.21.1 (see `.nvmrc`)

## Structure

```
app/                  # Next.js App Router
  layout.tsx          # Root layout (Navbar + Footer)
  page.tsx            # Home (hero, activities, CTA)
  about/              # About / history page
  blog/               # Blog index (placeholder posts)
  pricing/            # Membership pricing tiers
  providers.tsx       # next-themes wrapper
components/
  navbar.tsx          # Top navigation (HeroUI Link)
  footer.tsx          # Site footer
  theme-switch.tsx    # HeroUI Switch + next-themes
  counter.tsx         # Demo Button component
  icons.tsx           # SVG icons
  patterns/           # Reusable design system primitives
    section.tsx       # <Section> — semantic page section
    container.tsx     # <Container> — fixed max-width wrapper
    eyebrow.tsx       # <Eyebrow> — small uppercase label
    card-club.tsx     # <CardClub> — branded card with optional accent
    blurry-blob.tsx   # BlurryBlob — decorative animated background
config/
  site.ts             # Site metadata, nav items, social links
  design-tokens.ts    # Brand colors, typography, spacing, activities
  fonts.ts            # next/font configs (Inter, Fira Code)
styles/
  globals.css         # @import tailwindcss + @heroui/styles + @theme
types/
  index.ts            # IconSvgProps
```

## Design system

Tokens are defined in two places (kept in sync):

1. `styles/globals.css` — `@theme { ... }` block (Tailwind v4 native).
2. `config/design-tokens.ts` — TypeScript constants for `tailwind-variants`.

### Brand palette

- **`estu-azul`** `#0009A0` — primary brand blue.
- **`estu-amarillo`** `#EEE457` — primary brand yellow.
- Each has a 50–900 scale (`estu-azul-50` to `estu-azul-900`).

### Gradients

- `gradient-estu-1` — blue → yellow.
- `gradient-estu-2` — yellow → blue.
- `gradient-estu-radial` — radial fade for hero backgrounds.

### Surfaces (light/dark)

- `bg-background` / `text-foreground` — page background and text.
- `bg-surface` / `bg-surface-muted` — card / panel surfaces.
- `border-default-200` — standard border.

## HeroUI v3 conventions

- **No Provider** — components work without `<NextUIProvider>`.
- **Compound components** — `Card.Header`, `Card.Content`, etc.
- **Theme via `next-themes`** — HeroUI reads `data-theme` / `class="dark"`.
- **Switch / Button / Link** are imported from `@heroui/react`.

## Conventions

- Spanish copy (`lang="es"`).
- Tailwind utility classes; never inline styles.
- Use patterns from `components/patterns/` rather than ad-hoc layouts.
- Add new brand colours to **both** `globals.css` and `design-tokens.ts`.

## Common tasks

- **Add a page**: create `app/<route>/page.tsx`, import from `@/components/patterns`.
- **Add a token**: edit `styles/globals.css` (`@theme` block) + `config/design-tokens.ts`.
- **Add a navigation item**: edit `config/site.ts` (`navItems` + `navMenuItems`).
